description: VDD Phase 7b: Prepare one task for implementation — loads constitution, spec, plan, and contracts and returns the implementation instruction plus the impact-chain commit-message format. Read-only; the tool writes nothing — the host agent performs the code edits, verification, and commit. Pass taskId (e.g. "TASK-003") from the task returned by vdd_get_next_task. Run one task at a time, after vdd_get_next_task; for read-only inspection of tasks use vdd_get_next_task instead. Parameter relationships: taskId comes from vdd_get_next_task (format TASK-###); projectRoot must match the root used by earlier phases. On the hosted (stateless) endpoint, pass artifactFiles (constitution.md, spec.md, plan.md, contracts/, tasks.md) so the tool can embed the real task text and its AC/contract links; without it the tool returns a delegation envelope.

artifactFiles.description: Map of vdd/-relative artifact path → full file text, for the hosted (stateless) endpoint, which cannot read the caller filesystem; without it the tool returns a delegation envelope

projectRoot.description: Project root: directory that constitution.md and the vdd/ folder are written to and resolved against. Relative paths resolve from the current working directory; keep the same value across every phase (default ".")

taskId.description: Task ID to implement, format TASK-### (e.g., "TASK-003"); must be an id listed in the feature's tasks.md (see vdd_get_next_task)

name: vdd_implement

_phase.description: VDD phase that produced this result

error.description: Error message when the phase fails

gateResult.description: Quality-gate result, when the phase runs a gate

title: Implement Task
